task: HigherBits MCP HTTP auth and protected-source trust boundaries

snippets.description: Accepts only a bounded Bearer credential and rejects alternate identity headers and query identity inputs before dispatch.
snippets.content: const match = authorization?.match(/^Bearer (\S+)$/); if (!match || match[1].length > 512 || request.headers.has("x-api-key") || [...new URL(request.url).searchParams.keys()].some((key) => QUERY_IDENTITY_KEYS.has(key.toLowerCase()))) throw new CopyError(401, "invalid_identity");

snippets.description: Builds internal requests with only Authorization and Content-Type, fixed handler destinations, and validates identity before creating the MCP transport.
snippets.content: createInternalRequest(url, request) uses only Authorization and Content-Type; dispatchFirstPartyRoute switches only on /api/search and /api/mcp/component-source; handle calls the existing check handler with a synthetic Authorization-only request before handleStreamableHttpRequest.

snippets.description: Existing authority resolves API-key identity, checks ambient Clerk session mismatch, and does not fall back to session-only identity for keyed calls.
snippets.content: copyIdentity resolves the Bearer key, looks up an active API key, rejects when sessionId and keyUser differ, then returns keyUser ?? sessionId.

snippets.description: Existing source handler remains the authority for identity, request ID, copy admission, and protected response delivery.
snippets.content: POST obtains userId via copyIdentity, validates requestId, prepares source, calls admitCopy with action mcp and the persisted copy tier, and returns the payload only after admission.

snippets.description: Source tool input validates exact allowed keys, safe integers, and UUID before dispatch.
snippets.content: parseSourceArguments requires a safe-integer componentId, optional safe-integer demoId, and optional UUID requestId; it returns only those validated fields.

snippets.description: Only fetch-boundary TypeErrors from a preconstructed valid Request become retryable HigherBitsNetworkError instances; injected dispatcher errors are not classified as network failures.
snippets.content: The default dispatcher constructs Request before fetch, wraps fetch TypeError as HigherBitsNetworkError, and isTransientNetworkFailure recognizes only that class; handleSource reuses the same dispatchRequest for one retry.

snippets.description: Focused AC4 test proves an eligible fetch rejection retries once with an identical requestId/body and an injected in-process TypeError is called only once.
snippets.content: G-AC4-ERROR-RETRY mocks the default fetch boundary for a TypeError and verifies identical request bodies; an injected dispatcher TypeError rejects with one invocation.
